title: Hypertrophy training V.1
author: S A.
desc: Essentially just my first programme to get use to the gym and to have a proportionate physique where all the muscles are worked to an efficient and effective amount

ex.note: Use a hammer grip to hone in on the brachialis as well
Do a deficit pendlay row for more range of motion
Hold at full contraction
Use good technique, go lighter if you have to, use machine alternative if you want to go heavier
Preferably a strict curl, so against a wall, use an EZ bar if you want less strain on the wrists
Purely vertical posture to really target the upper traps
Raise above head and slight lean forward to lower traps
Use snatch grip to focus and target upper and middle traps
Use a Preacher curl machine specifically, but any machine will do
Slight lean forward as to focus on side delts
To work the wrist extension
Can get on your knees and  put your forearms on a bench and perform the first curl like that for better range of motion
Start with this so it gets the muscles ready for the other excercises
